column1: # Running story threads — OWNED AND MAINTAINED BY THE MORNING-BRIEFING AGENT.
# Format: Thread <TAB> Name <TAB> Google News query URL <TAB> opened=YYYY-MM-DD last_hit=YYYY-MM-DD
# Rules (applied every morning after compiling the briefing):
#   - Update last_hit when a thread produces a story worth including (or a clearly relevant development).
#   - OPEN a new thread when a story (a) recurs across 2+ days or 3+ outlets AND (b) is an unresolved
#     process: lawsuit, investigation, sale/merger, leadership search, legislation, protest wave, crisis.
#   - RETIRE (delete the line) when the story resolves or last_hit is more than 14 days old.
#   - Keep queries TIGHT: quote proper nouns, pair institution with story keywords, so the feed
#     returns the thread and not general coverage of the institution.
